name: flip-map-voice
description: Blind listening test of navigation voices for Flip Map. Development tool only; nothing here ships with the app.

scripts.setup-piper: $(command -v python3.13 || command -v python3) -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -q piper-tts==1.8.0 && .venv/bin/python -m piper.download_voices --data-dir models en_US-kristin-medium en_US-norman-medium
